From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-05T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood Intro & next steps — brief technical tour

Hi Sara / Samuel,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated learning more about HealthGrid's plan for document ingestion and the latency/cost sensitivity on inference for your clinical summarization workflow. Quick recap from our side and a suggested next step to keep momentum: 

Recap (short):
- Primary goal: reduce per‑document inference cost while keeping median latency below 300ms for single‑record lookups.
- Key constraints: HIPAA controls, customer‑managed keys, and a preference for private deployment in US regions.
- Stakeholders to include in the next session: your data infra lead and security owner so we can align on network and KMS requirements.

Suggested next step: 30‑minute technical tour (product + engineering) to walk through an integration pattern, runbook for onboarding, and our security pre‑read. I can host a concise session focused on:
- Integration patterns (S3/HTTPS ingestion + streaming inference)
- Latency/cost tradeoffs and recommended batching profiles
- Security controls and deployment options (Private, Dedicated)

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Option A: Fri Apr 9 — 10:00–10:30 AM PDT
- Option B: Sat Apr 10 — 03:00–03:30 PM PDT

If neither works, please suggest two slots that include your security and infra leads. I attached a short agenda (one page) that we’ll follow.

Next steps after we align the time: I’ll add Neha (security lead) to the invite and share a SOC2 summary and network diagram ahead of the call.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: diego.fernandez@redwood.com | M: (415) 555‑0198
https://www.redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-brief-agenda.pdf (1 page)

For timing, Option A looks good but could we shift to 11:00–11:30 AM PDT on Fri Apr 9 instead? That gives Priya time to join after a prior meeting. If that slot is fixed for you, we’ll confirm. Otherwise, please propose another nearby slot.

Thanks — Sara
